description: This source file defines a singleton class CLIInstallPrompter that manages prompting the user to install a CLI tool within a macOS app. It handles checking conditions for prompting, displaying alerts, initiating installation, and opening settings. It also includes a private actor StatusBox to manage transient status messages.

classes.name: CLIInstallPrompter
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for prompting the user to install the CLI tool, managing prompt states, and opening settings.

methods.name: checkAndPromptIfNeeded
methods.description: Checks if conditions are met to prompt the user for CLI installation and presents an alert accordingly.

methods.name: shouldPrompt
methods.description: Determines whether the prompt should be shown based on current app state and user defaults.

methods.name: installCLI
methods.description: Initiates asynchronous installation of the CLI and displays a completion message.

methods.name: openSettings
methods.description: Opens the settings window and navigates to the specified tab.

methods.name: appVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the application's version from the bundle info dictionary.
